name: Nebula Hearts
source:
Awaken to chaos aboard a drifting spaceship, where you navigate playful banter with your quirky crew. Choose your words wisely and confront the unknown – will you forge bonds or reveal hidden secrets?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一觉醒来，你发现自己身处一艘在太空中漂流的飞船，船上一片混乱。你和个性古怪的船员们打趣斗嘴，小心斟酌着言辞，一同面对未知。你会和他们结下羁绊，还是揭开那些埋藏的秘密？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
